changes: model_check.py and Check base / donor / result / any-model buttons; finished swaps are checked automatically.
Facial-hair meshes (M_Combinations, Beard, ...) are classified as hair, so a donor's beard is left out.
Donor S_ cages not driven by the outgoing .ycl are dropped (they rendered as black meshes).
All masks (donor HPL included) are pruned of points visible from 49 directions; fabric beyond the far side of a limb no longer counts as behind the skin.
environment: Native Windows 11 (owner's PC), Blender 4.4 and 5.2, Python 3.14

checks.ui_construction: app constructed with the new Check buttons (entry script's stale v0.4 version assertion fails afterwards, as in v0.5.3).
checks.build_integrity: repackaged from v0.5.3; model_check.py added as a helper; bundled helpers equal the tested files.
checks.callum_newman: Donor beard left out; S_Jacket cage dropped; 0 hide-mask holes by Check result.

limitations: Not tested in WWE 2K26 by Claude.
Generated masks are a rest-pose coverage estimate; a few small specks can remain, and skin at garment edges may show in extreme poses.
A copied base .ycl also describes the base attire's clothing cages.
